body:
## Purpose and current status

REC-H5-ELECTRON-FIELD01 constructs a source-equivalent FULL electron point field with explicit incoming radiation and no history writes. Theory R1–R10 is complete with fresh nonauthor R6 PASS_SCOPED. C1–C7 are complete and delivered. C8 independent numerical validation is in progress. C6 made 2 new valid control calls, and C7 captured exactly 132 new primary calls. Full 132-point parity and residual admission remains pending C8 and fresh C9.

- Actual completed content and delivered stages: **17/20**.

- Primary scope: FULL/H_STEADY/He-neutral/xe=xHII/fsR=meR=1.
- Frozen FH gate: 512 eps64 S_F; independent block residual: 4096 eps64. Bitwise counts reported separately.
- Old full-history/native producer/reference/audit/QSS03/old-test reruns: 0 by this work.
